data.name: Al H.
data.headline: Murals Transform Small Spaces
data.description:
Here is a photo of your mural applied in a small, downstairs kitchenette. The space is quite limited so a more open view could not be obtained.

The mural opens up the cramped quarters giving the illusion of sitting at a counter and lookimg out at a Parisienne sidewalk cafe street scene. Very effective.

The mural quality is high and installation was no problem. Thanks for transforming this small space into a sidwalk cafe! It is rare in these market times to have so much interest and support given to web customers and greatly appreciated.'

data.description:

The mural and your service are both outstanding and I am a happy customer! The handwritten note is also a nice, unexpected personal touch. Thanks very much!'

data.name: Andrea F.
data.headline: Location, Location, Location
data.description: In the restaurant business, sometimes location is more important than the quality of food or service. Location is everything in many businesses. Celebrating your location with vintage maps and images of the city you're in is an easy and inexpensive way of bonding with your customers and displaying your commitment to your community. Call us and we'll find the right maps and images for your location.
